[spoiler=Recapture of Therene and Valdderan response to the CA][b]Friday the 11th, December 2026[/b]
[i]A voice in the radio rises up, broadcasted on all channels in Valddera.[/i]

Acting interim leader Nadir Suleiman speaks with you, I announce, people of Valddera. That we have recaptured Therene and successfully defended Serene from the bloodthirsty terrorists of the "Islamic State". After three successful military campaigns in southern Valddera, we are officially announcing that turning point in war, and we are pushing for the restoration of Vald, as of course. Rest in peace all martyrs, children and fighters, may Allah have mercy on them.

As well, Valddera thanks every single person, nation and family that helped in the war, as I see lots of people holding up flags and celebrating in Therene, don't let your guard down yet. As this war hasn't ended, prepare for everything, everyone. Therene isn't just a city, it's both an urban hub of Valddera, and a 3400 year old city, a crossroads of our history, our industry and our culture. And to all people of Therene, who endured and survived the occupation with diginity and courage; your nation has not forgotten you. Yout suffering strengthened our resolve, and your resilience inspired every soldier who marched to free you.

About other sides, Valddera with the help of Hydronian forces are actively attempting to find the radical leader of the Islamic State, Hassan Al-Amin, and I assure you that your end will not be pleasant Hassan, we have been noted to where you are and we are going to find you. You are slowly losing ground and running won't be as useful, as before.

And regarding Tirakan, citizens of Valddera, People of Tirakan who listen beyond the front lines, And leaders of the Coastal Alliance; hear my words clearly.

Earlier these weeks, the Coastal alliance of Tirakan issued a response to Valddera and the Renaissance Union, they accuse us of interfering in Tirakan's affairs simply by extending support to the Renaissance Union. Let there not be farther conflict for Tirakan, but if you are warning us and not "Recongizing" our state, we don't either. And for that, we have no interest in invading your lands nor in exploiting your conflicts, but we will not; and i repeat, will not be intimidated by a faction that can barely keep up with your lands, and now it believes it can dictate terms beyond it's own borders.

Speaking of the Coastal Alliance and the Renaissance Union, I order the Coastal Alliance to give up some of their coastal ranges to the Renaissance Union, to have farther and easier access to their islands. And if you were not to comply, we will threaten you with military intervention, just because we are seen as unstable from the civil war, even though we clearly have had the upper hand in it. We are not uncapable of anything, we could have unwanted conflicts if you want to.

To the holy league, Valddera has noted their movement as a political and cultral actor with deep roots in Tirakan's religious heritage, while we do not fully endorse theocratic governance, we do acknowledge the holy league's influence among Tirakan's communities and districts, therefore we call upon the Renaissance Union and the Holy league to begin formal unification discussions with agreed terms and conditions from both sides, as Valddera's main purpose is to unite the Tirakan and secure farther unity across East Shamat, and we push for more factions in Tirakan to think about this proposal of unity, along with the anarchist movements; your lands aren't relevant alone, Live under a head of a state better than nothing of a state.

Regards, Nadir Suleiman.

Long live Valddera.

Long live our people.

Long live the Republic.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=I spaced out my text this time][quote=vespurias;60719803][b]The Neutral Principality[/b]

It is with no uncertainty that the war office has been quiet since the last century ended, and the foreign office is bereft of aggressiveness. What enemies could they have? Only person who could make a claim on Eneas is Llyndorra through it's Monarchy, otherwise, Eneas has been it's own thing for ages. Even a Pan-Argossian entity would struggle to even get Eneas to be a part of it.

Yet when news came about this neutral...Non-Aligned Bloc, well, the Prince just had to subtly nudge the Chancellor Beanwood to send a few diplomatic envoys to the Eastern Nation about joining such a thing. After all, neutrality is great for businesses and means Eneas can continue to live lavishly without a care for war. Why would they? They have literally no interests beyond commercial and economic with the wider Erene.

So they'd officially send a request to join.[/quote][/spoiler]
[b]NAB, New Member?[/b]

The King sat in the Audience Room, awaiting the arrival of the diplomatic envoy of Eneas. He stood up and did his usual routine of fixing his watch on his wrist, adjusting his shirt collar, fixing the cuffs on his wrists, and standing up straight. In Minhokae, the monarch was the one who had the final say on treaties, foreign discussion, and in this case, his country's neutrality bloc. With him, he had his aide-de-camp, Do-yun Park, who the King preferred to keep by his side in political circumstances where his input was necessary. Today, a royal guard was to open the doors for the envoy instead of simply standing guard, as the King insisted that Do-yun stay by him when they walked in.

Not long after, a guard came by and opened the door. "The Eneas Diplomatic Envoy to Minhokae, Your Majesty." the guard said while bowing. "Thank you. Send him in please." The guard bowed again, turned around, and had the diplomatic envoy sent in. The King shook their hands. 

"Welcome, gentlemen, to Minhokae. Shall we begin?"

[b]Elseyran Defense Union Announces Expansion of Membership to Krilmor[/b]

[i]The Elseyran Committee announced on Friday the accession of the northern Elseyran nation of Krilmor to the Elseyran Defense Union. In a speech to the Union Assembly following a finalizing vote on the entrance of Krilmor, Neue Republik representative Leon Schmidt stated that the agreement Strengthens the security status of the Union and significantly expands the scope of the Union's single market. This will be a significant boon to both the people of Krilmor and the EDU. 

The agreement, which has been in the making for several months through negotiations, is the second recent expansion of the EDU. Associate status for Daesun and now the full status of Krilmor as a member will expand the tariff-free, standardized customs union and visa-free single Elseyran market. Analysts from the EDU and Republik predict that Krilmor's entrance into the EDU and the ensuing reduction in trade barriers will help boost trade volume in the Elseyran economic sphere. Lower prices for energy, products, and services are expected as imports into Krilmor from Elseyr become more and more efficient. EUF status for Krilmor will also help provide backing for the Krilmor economy in times of crisis, helping to bail out the economy in potential recessions as well as boosting investor confidence in the status quo. 

EDU status will also now reduce the number of barriers for Krilmor in purchasing advanced weaponry from other Elseyran states, as well as help to standardize military equipment to reduce logistical barriers. Full collective defense will be applied to Krilmor to aid in deterrence and provide a nuclear umbrella to the country. [/i]

[b]On security in Tirakan[/b]

[i]The Republik heeds the call of the Free Republic of Naerim. 

Valdderan intervention in the conflict in Tirakan is unacceptable. The blatant support and military intervention in favor of the militarist and undemocratic Renaissance Union regime, along with threats to use unprovoked armed force against the Coastal Alliance and the FRN is not tolerable. 

Such heavy-handed use of force seeks to inflame an already costly and disastrous humanitarian crisis in Tirakan. The backing of the Renaissance Union is backing of further bloodshed and suffering. 

The regime of Valddera has broken international norms in its imperialist ambitions in Tirakan. Democracy and the freedom of the people of the Free Republic are at stake. Under these conditions, the hand of the Republik has been forced to heed the call of the FRN for international support and fight for democracy in Tirakan. 

Under the orders of Chancellor Vogt, the Hochdeutsche Defense Forces (HDF) have deployed seven amphibious ready groups and the NRS Seewolf and NRS Graf Sachsen to the area. The Republik demands that the Valdderan regime immediately withdraw its illegal use of force from the area.[/i]

[b]Deployment to Valddera[/b]

[i]Daesun strongly condemn's Valddera's military action in Tirakan, the support for a totalitarian militarist regime is completely illegal and unacceptable. Valddera has proven itself to be an unstable state, failing to take out the ISV and forces of Democratic Valddera within its borders even with heavy handed foreign support. Something must be done.

In solidarity with Tirakan, and the good of the Valdderan people, Daesun [b]terminates[/b] its mutual defence pact with Valddera. Stating the current government as illegitimate and incompetent, therefore, a new government must be formed. One that could be fostered by Daesun and the rest of the world to be reintegrated into the international community as a peaceful state.  

To achieve this though, a harsh approach had to be instated.

Under the direct command of the Daesunite Department of War, military installations within Valddera were put into high alert and acted under the complete control of the Daesunite Defencive Command. While AAS and naval saturation assets were deployed within striking range of the Valdderan coast. A warnings about potential intervention into Valddera were dispatched to all active nations within the nation to ensure no friendly fire took place. 

Even before any actions were to take place, Daesun requested a diplomatic channel be formed between the Valdderan government and Daesun to promote dialogue over potential mediation of the conflict.[/i]
